title: The WP Custom Admin Interface plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'first_name'…
description: The WP Custom Admin Interface plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'first_name' parameter affecting all versions up to and including 7.43. This flaw allows authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher to inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages.
